Built as a personal AI

Not a generic feed. You speak in plain language; Aria turns that into routines and follows them.

Conversation

Type or use the mic while the app is open. It understands tasks, places, and topics.

Memory for routines

Every N days, snooze, and “done” — schedules shift from the day you choose.

Context around you

Local weather and keyword topics you pick, without noisy city-wide spam.

Private by design

Your account, your routines. Sign-in with email verification.

Start in a few minutes

  1. Install on a device or open Aria in the browser.
  2. Create an account and verify the email code.
  3. Allow notifications so Aria can reach you.
  4. Tell it what to remember — confirm when it proposes a plan.

Install on iPhone or iPad

  1. Open Safari.
  2. Open Aria in the browser.
  3. Tap Share → Add to Home Screen.
  4. Open from the icon and allow notifications when asked.
Open Aria

Install on Windows

  1. Open Aria in Chrome or Edge.
  2. Menu → Install app.
  3. Launch from Start like any other program.
